$comment: Source of truth for this sector of the partner programs tracker (scripts/partner-programs.mjs). Record a submission with npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "...", a benefit with npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "...". Never set status member without proof. Never store organization, workspace, or account IDs here.

programs.apply: Create a Steamworks partner account, verify tax details and pay the per-app fee.
programs.value: Distribution of a /play desktop build to the Steam audience.
programs.eligibility: Any developer or company.
programs.cost: USD 100 per app, recouped after USD 1,000 revenue
programs.next: Evaluate a Steam release of /play with a 30 day lead time.
programs.why: Steam takes 30 percent. The fee is documented by Valve. A real self-serve door with household reach.

programs.cadence: themed calls several times a year (a Spring 2026 cohort is reported)
programs.next: Check lift.comcast.com/accelerator for the current call and apply with a talking-avatar media pitch.
programs.why: Recent calls were AI themed and run by Comcast directly. I could not confirm an open call on 2026-11-06.
programs.promo_note: Comcast corporate publishes stories and cohort announcements about LIFT Labs startups.

programs.why: Page looks older, so reply times may differ. Partial profiles are not reviewed.

programs.apply: Click Become a Seller and complete the three-step application, then submit a first offering for review.
programs.value: A listing on Siemens' industrial marketplace puts our embeddable 3D agent in front of digital twin and factory buyers.
benefits: Siemens governance review as trust signal
programs.eligibility: Technology companies, system integrators and solution providers; offerings pass security and interoperability review (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).

programs.next: Apply as a seller with the agent-3d embed as an offering for 3D digital twin viewing and assistant guidance.
programs.why: The industrial digital twin audience wants viewers plus conversational agents; a self-serve seller route is the most realistic door at any company on this list. Security review (ISO 27001) may be a hurdle.

programs.apply: Submit the partner application and choose the Build motion.

programs.apply: Register an app in the Spotify developer dashboard with a Premium account.
programs.value: Self-serve API access for prototypes such as an avatar that reacts to the listener's music.

programs.apply: Submit the Quota Extension Request for New Potential Partners from a company email.

programs.next: Build on development mode only and revisit at 250k users.
programs.why: Spotify also bans using its content to train AI models and requires Premium for dev mode, so use is limited to playback and metadata. Gap: we cannot meet 250k MAU.
